from pyspark.sql.functions import col, dense_rank
from pyspark.sql.window import Window 

# 1. Garantir que a database gold existe
spark.sql("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS gold")

# 2. Definição do caminho base para a Gold de Armazém no ADLS Gen2
path_gold = "abfs://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/warehouse/4. GOLD"

# 3. Leitura da tabela Silver de Armazém
df_silver_wh = spark.table("silver.tb_wh")

# 4. Isolar registros únicos de armazém e gerar a Surrogate Key (sk_wh)
window_wh = Window.orderBy("warehouse_id")

df_dim_wh = (
    df_silver_wh 
    .select("warehouse_id","sensor_type")
    .distinct()
    .filter(col("warehouse_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("sk_wh", dense_rank().over(window_wh))
    .select("sk_wh","warehouse_id", "sensor_type")
)

# 5. Gravação da dim_wh Delta na Gold

(df_dim_wh.write
.format("delta")
.mode("overwrite")
.option("path", f"{path_gold}/dim_wh")
.saveAsTable("gold.dim_wh")
